parsed.rationale: The 'taboo-api - Get All Stored Categories' API provides a list of categories which can be used to gather popular music genres, directly satisfying the subtask of gathering music genres. It requires no parameters and is more specific to categories than broad music charts or unrelated commerce or sports APIs.
